scenario: Neon serverless pooler behavior under SharedBackend conformance
singleAndLowConcurrency: PROVEN — migrations, CRUD, single-op CAS and incr pass reliably
highConcurrencyConformance: CONDITIONED — the 50-way concurrent CAS/append/incr and distributed-race conformance tests are non-deterministic under the Neon pooler endpoint (non-deterministic failures, no thrown connection error; operations return wrong values). This is consistent with pooler connection-session desync / read-after-write inconsistency on the pooled endpoint, NOT a defect in the substrate SQL (which is proven on local PostgreSQL in Phases 4.6–4.8).
mitigation: Use Neon direct (non-pooler) endpoint, or PgBouncer in transaction mode, or route all durable control-plane reads/writes on a single primary connection so read-after-write consistency holds.
